papers.title: Agents' Last Exam
papers.abstract: Benchmark evaluating AI agents on long-horizon, economically valuable real-world tasks across 13 industry clusters with 1K+ tasks, revealing significant gaps between benchmark performance and practical deployment.

papers.title: DEI: Diversity in Evolutionary Inference for Quality-Diversity Search
papers.abstract: Distributed Quality-Diversity search framework using heterogeneous large language models as mutation operators, demonstrating that model diversity improves performance over homogeneous parallel approaches.

papers.title: Liberating LLM Capabilities in Full-Duplex Speech Models
papers.abstract: Text-first tri-channel speech interface enabling real-time interaction with visible text output alongside spoken responses, demonstrating superior performance in full-duplex conversational tasks.

papers.title: Light-WAM: Efficient World Action Models with State-Fusion Action Decoding
papers.abstract: Lightweight world action model for robot manipulation using compact video backbone and downsampled latent space for efficient future-video supervision, combined with direct action prediction.

papers.title: SDR: Set-Distance Rewards for Radiology Report Generation
papers.abstract: Set-based rewards using embedding distances improve chest X-ray report generation by enabling effective post-training and test-time selection without requiring causal reasoning structures.

papers.title: Robotic Policy Adaptation via Weight-Space Meta-Learning
papers.abstract: Weight-space meta-learning framework generating task-specific LoRA parameters for frozen VLA policies using language instructions and demonstration videos, enabling efficient task adaptation.

papers.title: AsyncWebRL: Efficient Multi-Step RL for Visual Web Agents
papers.abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning improves vision-language web agent training through system-level and algorithmic optimizations, achieving faster throughput and better performance on challenging tasks.

papers.title: Phase Marginalization for Patch-Grid Instability in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract: Post-hoc method addressing phase-dependent instability in Vision Transformers by evaluating structured patch-grid phases and aggregating outputs in the original image coordinate system.

papers.title: SigmaScale: LLM Compression with SVD-based Low-Rank Decomposition and Learned Scaling Matrices
papers.abstract: Learns auxiliary scaling matrices to improve truncated SVD-based LLM compression by adapting to individual weight structures through activation-aware transformations for efficient inference.

papers.title: Send a SCOUT First: Pre-hoc Reasoning for Adaptive Detector Allocation in Prompt-Injection Defense
papers.abstract: SCOUT framework dynamically allocates prompt-injection detection by predicting detector reliability and latency, improving safety and efficiency over fixed single-detector approaches.

cc_updates.body:
Introducing Claude Fable 5: a Mythos-class model that we've made safe for general use. Fable's capabilities exceed those of any model we've ever made generally available. Update to version 2.1.170 for access.

Fixed sessions not saving transcripts (and not appearing in --resume) when launched from the VS Code integrated terminal or any shell that inherited Claude Code environment variables.

Added `--safe-mode` flag and `CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE` to disable customizations for troubleshooting. Added `/cd` command to move sessions to new directories. Added `disableBundledSkills` setting. Fixed arrow key navigation in input history, MCP policy enforcement, UI stalls on macOS, slow `claude -p` on Windows, Remote Control reconnection issues, Git credential popups, footer hints, permission prompts, and numerous agent view fixes. Improved TaskCreate reliability and error messages. Reduced CPU usage during streaming.
